title: 1955 AHSME Problem 7
statement: If a worker receives a \(20\) percent cut in wages, he may regain his original pay exactly by obtaining a raise of:

solutions.text:
If the original wage is \(W,\) the reduced wage is \(0.8W.\) The needed increase is \(0.2W,\) which as a fraction of the reduced wage is \[ \frac{0.2W}{0.8W}=\frac14=25\%. \]

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: After the cut, the wage is \(80\%\) of the original
Find the percent of the reduced wage represented by the missing \(20\%\) of the original
